$comment: Citation ledger. Every 'evidence' id used anywhere in this design-repo resolves here. 'path' is relative to the SOURCE PROJECT ROOT (the folder that contains design-repo/ when it ships beside its clone). extraction/verify_all.py checks: the id exists (always, error); and, when the sibling source file is present, that the line range is within the file and the anchor text occurs inside that range (error). When the source tree is absent (e.g. this folder was unzipped on its own) external checks degrade to warnings. Anchors are structural (headings, class names, identifiers) and never marketing copy.

copyBudgetMethod: maxWords = ceil(observedMaxWords * 1.2) for each slot, where observedMaxWords is the longest EN string measured for that slot in the source i18n messages (src/i18n/en.js, keyed as in the cited spec section). Only the COUNTS are recorded here; the strings themselves are deliberately not reproduced anywhere in this repo.

sectionHeights.$comment: Rendered height of every template section at 1440x900 on every route of templates/routes.json, written by extraction/measure_sections.mjs from a local production build of the clone (vite build + vite preview) and read by extraction/wrapper_gate.py. inFlow=false = position fixed/absolute (an overlay that takes no page height). chrome.grid-frame is the sum of the 1px frame separators. Legal pages are split at their top-level <hr> rules.
sectionHeights.source: local production build of the sibling clone (npx vite build --outDir <scratch>; npx vite preview --port 5705)
